jobs.title: Principal, Program Manager - Technology Strategy & Enterprise Integration (Flexible location)
jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 174893

Job Category: Project / Program Management

Job Level: Manager/Principal

Business Unit: Energy Delivery

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Oakland

Department Overview

Welcome to Electric Asset Strategy (EAS). We are responsible for the Distribution electric system’s asset strategy, standards, procedures and end-to-end risk management for 2.3 million structures. We deliver a risk informed strategic plan, leveraging inspection insights and asset data to drive strategic maintenance and investment decisions.

The Distribution Asset Risk Management (ARM) team—comprising Asset Failure Analysis (AFA), Asset Insights, and Inspections & Maintenance Strategy (I&M)—focuses on continuously improving on how PG&E monitors and maintains its assets to support a resilient, reliable grid to help keep our communities safe.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Director of ARM, the Principal Program Manager will ensure the enterprise data, analytics, and technology initiatives ARM depends on deliver what our teams need to make decisions more effectively and efficiently. This role collaborates extensively across the company to translate ARM’s needs into clear requirements, shape enterprise initiatives early, and integrate the resulting capabilities into ARM’s core workflows. The role will also facilitate the team’s adoption and proficiency with enterprise AI/ML tools and, working closely with ARM’s Principal Program Manager for Advanced Technology, lead the integration and scaling of new technologies once they have been successfully tested and piloted.

The I&M team plays a critical role in managing 80,000 circuit miles of overhead primary conductors in California. We are continually improving on inspection and asset maintenance methods and procedures based on testing insights, failure analysis, and SME input. The successful candidate will serve as a strategic integrator and champion for ARM’s needs across the enterprise to deliver several transformative initiatives.

•    ARM Data & AI/ML Strategy: Develop and maintain ARM’s asset data strategy, including the data foundations, quality, and governance needed to support risk-informed decisions. Define what ARM’s data and workflows need to be AI/ML-ready, and guide how enterprise AI/ML capabilities are applied to ARM’s challenges.

•    I&M Decision Support: Improve data product tooling that leads to improved prioritization and bundling of maintenance work to maximize risk reduction per dollar.

•    AI/ML Capability Building: Coach ARM team members, one-on-one and as a group, to get the most from enterprise AI/ML tools such as Copilot and Foundry AIP. Identify high-value use cases and drive adoption to improve team efficiency and effectiveness.

•    Asset Knowledge Product Development: Liaise with Asset Knowledge Management (AKM), PG&E’s enterprise team for asset data products and analytics, and the Data Management & Analytics team to guide development and adoption of analytics tools and data visualization products that support ARM decision-making.
•    Propel Integration: Partner with the enterprise Propel program that is rebuilding PG&E’s backend data infrastructure. Engage early to shape requirements, design choices, and data definitions so today’s key pain points are addressed in the build, then lead system adoption and integration.

This is a hybrid role, working remotely and/or at your assigned PG&E location based on business needs and candidate preference. The ideal candidate is a data savvy leader who thrives in fast paced environments and seeks to make a meaningful impact on grid safety, resilience, and customer service. Conference travel may be required several times per year.

PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job.  The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors . This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

A reasonable salary range is:​
Bay Area Minimum: $144,000
Bay Area Mid-Point: $194,000
Bay Area Maximum: $244,000
&/OR​
CA Minimum: $137,000
CA Mid-Point: $184,000
CA Maximum: $232,000

Job Responsibilities

•    Develop and maintain strong working relationships with all strategic programs and partners, external and internal (Asset Knowledge Management, Propel, Data Management & Analytics, Risk and Data Analytics, IT, enterprise AI teams, etc.)
•    Report-outs to leaders in EAM in WORs and MORs, and as needed to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT).
•    Performs or leads feasibility analysis, business case development, develop project scope, and provide recommendations on the alternative solutions, project strategy and deliverable prioritization. Collaborates with Electric leadership on asset data management issues and initiatives.
•    Recognized subject matter expert who represents PG&E in regulatory and/or industry forums on subject of expertise.
•    Coaches and mentors less experienced employees
•    Solves unique and complex problems, anticipating issues and developing innovative solutions.
•    Demonstrates strategic leadership with internal stakeholders to support Company goals.
•    Leads development of program goals and metrics to meet company goals and objectives.  Collaborates across organization to ensure alignment of goals to support program.
•    Organize and lead cross-utility project teams to influence utility, regulatory and/or industry decisions.
•    Develops or provides significant input to PG&E leadership, other utilities with similar programs, industry and/or regulatory decision makers to influence market place and regulatory strategies impacting PG&E and its customers.

Qualifications

Minimum:

•    Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
•    10 years of related experience or equivalent

Desired:

•    Master’s in Business Administration or other Advanced Degree
•    Ability to comprehend complex systems and data infrastructure to help drive strategic decision making, and to recommend operational improvements
•    Experience in working in large datasets, data strategy and/or data governance, and understanding the management or training of AI and/or large language models
•    Experience in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) analytics
•    Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification
•    Highly skilled at leading cross-functional project teams. Experience leading cross cutting programs and/or technology deployments
•    Travel may be required
•    In depth knowledge of energy and/or electric utility industry processes, regulatory requirements, critical success factors, goals and initiatives.
•    Ability to lead large and complex projects working with cross-functional teams
•    Ability to create compelling business cases based on complex business environments and inputs
•    Adept at addressing issues with diplomacy and tact

jobs.title: Program Manager, Expert
jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 174597

Job Category: Project / Program Management

Job Level: Individual Contributor

Business Unit: Technology & Security

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Oakland; San Ramon

Department Overview

It is an exciting time to be at PG&E as we are embarking on our 10-year True North Strategy, an enterprise strategy that sets a clear vision of what it means to achieve our Purpose:  Delivering for Our Hometowns, Serving Our Planet, and Leading with Love.

Information Systems Technology Services is a unified organization comprised of various departments which collaborate effectively in order to deliver high quality technology solutions. Powering PG&E with innovative solutions & services that drive reliability, security, and customer satisfaction. We are the trusted, climate-resilient, smart, digital utility platform that redefines the customer energy experience.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and accomplished Expert Program Manager to lead and manage a portfolio of Enterprise data, analytics and artificial intelligence portfolio. This expert role requires a strategic leader with a proven track record in delivering complex projects within defined timelines, budgets, and scope. Adept in managing stakeholder expectations, foster seamless cross-functional collaboration, and driven by a passion for innovative problem-solving.

PG&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity,   specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location.  The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint $129,000 - $168,000. The final decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to the factors above.  This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

Bay Area Min: $ 129,000

Bay Area Max: $ 207,000

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and our Oakland Headquarters or San Ramon Valley Conference Center 2-3 days per week based on business need. The assigned work location will be within the PG&E Service Territory.

Job Responsibilities

- Serve as the enterprise intake and orchestration lead for AI initiatives, ensuring investments are aligned to corporate strategy, value realization, and responsible AI principles.

- Lead a portfolio of high-impact data, analytics, and AI programs, providing program governance, delivery oversight, and executive-level reporting.

- Enable enterprise data and AI transformation by collaborating with business, technology, and data management teams to improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and innovation.

- Manage program and project budgets, ensuring financial resources are used efficiently and projects are completed within the allocated budget.

- Identify potential risks to the success of projects and develop comprehensive mitigation plans to address these risks proactively.

- Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effective communication among team members from different departments to achieve project objectives.

- Regularly update stakeholders on project progress, changes, and any issues that arise, ensuring transparency and alignment with business objectives.

- Track project milestones and assess the performance of projects to ensure they meet the set objectives and deliver the expected outcomes.

- Ensure project teams have the necessary resources, including personnel, technology, and tools, for timely and efficient execution of their tasks.

- Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, communication plans, risk logs, and status reports, to ensure all project information is accurately recorded and accessible.

- Ensure robust project governance to ensure compliance with internal audit requirements

- Drive continuous improvement and innovation in the delivery of IT programs by identifying opportunities for process enhancements and implementing best practices.

Skills:

- Strong understanding of artificial intelligence and data analytics digital trends.

- Has led large scale complex programs to successful completion

- Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

- Proven ability to manage budgets and resources.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

- Ability to collaborate effectively and drive clarity in ambiguous situations

- Passionate and driven self-starter who consistently strives to achieve outstanding results.

Qualifications

Minimum:

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or job-related discipline or equivalent experience

- 8 years of experience in technology programs and project management

Desired:

- 5+ years of experience in managing AI projects

- 5+ years of experience in demand management

- Experience in PPM Tool such as Planisware

- PMP from PMI

- SAFe Agilist

- SAFe Lean Portfolio Management

jobs.title: Program Manager, Senior
jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175033

Job Category: Project / Program Management

Job Level: Individual Contributor

Business Unit: Energy Delivery

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Bakersfield; Chico; Fresno; Stockton

Department Overview

T&S is responsible for the maintenance and construction of the Electric Transmission system, Project and Construction, Generation Interconnections, Work and Resource Management, Compliance and Temporary Generation departments.  The Coworkers of Electric Transmission and Substation Operations ensure the delivery of safe and reliable electric service to our customers.

Program Overview

The Transmission Line Wildfire Mitigation Program consists of a portfolio of work from current and historical notifications to repair or replace transmission line assets across the system.  With an annual budget over $500M, this work is critical in improving the safety of our customers and the communities where they live.  Notifications are created from annual and ad-hoc inspections.  Work is prioritized based on location and ignition risk.

Position Summary

Manages aspects of the Transmission Line Wildfire Mitigation Program (WMP) clearing dependencies for work execution. This includes working with various partners to ensure the environmental release-to-construction (ERTC), all required permits (i.e. Caltrans), Landing Zones, Laydown Yards, and job drawings are received.  Works closely with a Project Controls Analyst, Work and Resource Planner, Construction Management, M&C Supervisors, and Construction Contractors to coordinate readiness for work over assigned Headquarters.

This position requires the ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently. Good written and verbal communication skills are required to facilitate meetings and forge partnerships with multiple stakeholders.

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office, and your assigned location based on business need. Headquarter location is flexible within the Transmission North Valley Region.

Disclosure:

PG&E is providing the salary range that can reasonably be expected for this position at the time of the job posting. This salary range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location.

The decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors. ​   This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

Pay Range:

- Minimum:  $100,00

- Midpoint:  $130,00

- Maximum:  $161,00

Job Responsibilities

- Conducts business in a safe and ethical manner in accordance with company standard practices. Works with key stakeholders to develop an annual workplan. Communicates execution risk, workplan changes, and issues to management and partners

- Escalates items as needed to ensure resources are utilized wisely. Works with little guidance to complete assignments and solves problems of moderate scope and complexity. Works with little guidance on moderately complex issues

- Works with support teams to obtain Caltrans, Railroad, City, and County encroachment permits

- Works with support teams to ensure all temporary construction easements for access, landing zones, and laydown yards are obtained. Works with environmental teams to obtain the ERTC.

- Works with engineering and estimating teams to ensure job drawings are complete.Tracks portfolio of work and any remaining dependencies. Communicates with peers, exchanging ideas and experiences.

Qualifications

Minimum:

- Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Finance or related discipline or equivalent experience

- Five (5) years of related experience or equivalent

Desired

- PMI-Project Management Institute PMP-Project Management Professional certification

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (excel, power point)

jobs.title: Expert Program Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 174850

Job Category: Project / Program Management

Job Level: Individual Contributor

Business Unit: Energy Delivery

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Vacaville

Department Overview

FlightCore (11 FTEs) serves as PG&E Aviation's centralized flight coordination, scheduling, and dispatch organization, supporting all crewed and uncrewed aerial operations across PG&E's service territory. As the operational hub for aviation activities, FlightCore provides enterprise-wide oversight of aircraft utilization, mission prioritization, resource allocation, regulatory compliance, and operational risk management.

The department is responsible for coordinating thousands of aviation missions that support critical utility operations, including wildfire mitigation, electric and gas infrastructure inspections, emergency response, vegetation management, and system restoration efforts. FlightCore ensures safe, efficient, and compliant operations through real-time mission monitoring, flight planning, airspace coordination, and deconfliction of aerial resources operating throughout PG&E territory.

Working closely with internal business partners, aviation leadership, and external stakeholders, FlightCore enables the strategic deployment of aviation resources while maintaining the highest standards of safety, operational excellence, and service reliability.

Position Summary

The FlightCore Program Manager, Expert serves as a key business partner to the FlightCore Manager, providing strategic planning, operational analysis, governance, training, program management, and technology implementation support to advance FlightCore's mission as the central coordination hub for Aviation Services. Working closely with the FlightCore Manager, this role leads process improvement initiatives, develops performance metrics and operating standards, oversees workforce readiness programs, and serves as the primary business lead supporting the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of FlightCore's Flight Operations Management System.

Under the direction of the FlightCore Manager, this position helps translate organizational priorities into operational plans, system requirements, performance metrics, standardized processes, training programs, and continuous improvement initiatives that enable safe, efficient, and scalable aviation operations across helicopter, fixed-wing, and UAS programs. The role serves as FlightCore's primary program management resource and provides the analytical, governance, and change management support necessary to continuously improve operational performance, technology adoption, and customer service.

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business needs or company requirements. The assigned work location will be within the PG&E Service Territory and will be agreed upon by the successful candidate and hiring leader.

PG&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint. The final decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

Bay Area Min: $129,000

Bay Area Mid: $168,000

Bay Area Max: $207,000

Job Responsibilities

Operational Planning & Resource Management

- Analyze operational demand, aircraft utilization, and resource capacity to support efficient mission execution.

- Develop business cases and recommendations that improve operational effectiveness, customer service, and resource utilization.

- Partner with the FlightCore Manager to support strategic planning and operational readiness initiatives.

- Monitor operational trends and recommend actions to improve service delivery and performance.

Program Governance & Performance Management

- Establish and maintain FlightCore performance metrics, operational scorecards, dashboards, and reporting tools.

- Develop executive reports, presentations, and operational reviews for Aviation leadership.

- Facilitate governance meetings and track strategic initiatives, action items, and leadership commitments.

- Monitor program performance and recommend corrective actions and improvement opportunities.

- Support development of long-range goals and operational objectives.

Flight Operations Management System Strategy & Implementation

- Serve as the primary business lead supporting the FlightCore Manager for the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of FlightCore's Flight Operations Management System.

- Partner with software vendors, Aviation leadership, FlightCore personnel, and stakeholders to identify business needs and operational requirements.

- Lead requirements gathering, business process mapping, workflow design, and operational use-case development.

- Translate Aviation business needs into functional requirements, user stories, testing criteria, and implementation plans.

- Coordinate system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), issue resolution, and deployment readiness activities.

- Develop implementation, training, and change management strategies that drive successful adoption across Aviation Services.

- Monitor project milestones, risks, dependencies, budgets, and performance metrics associated with system development.

- Drive continuous improvement and future enhancements that improve scheduling, dispatch, documentation, reporting, compliance tracking, resource management, and operational visibility.

- Serve as the primary liaison between FlightCore and software vendors to ensure business objectives are met and operational requirements are incorporated into system development.

Process Improvement & Technology Enablement

- Lead process improvement initiatives that improve safety, efficiency, quality, and customer experience.

- Identify and implement opportunities for workflow automation and technology enhancements.

- Support implementation of scheduling, dispatch, reporting, analytics, and operational technology solutions.

- Analyze business processes and recommend scalable solutions.

- Drive continuous improvement efforts that reduce inefficiencies and improve operational consistency.

- Support advancement of FlightCore's digital transformation roadmap through implementation of technology and automation solutions.

- Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and enhance operational visibility.

Training, Standards & Workforce Readiness

- Develop and maintain FlightCore operating procedures, job standards, training materials, operating manuals, and knowledge repositories.

- Lead onboarding, qualification, and recurring training programs for FlightCore personnel.

- Establish knowledge management frameworks that support workforce continuity and succession planning.

- Ensure consistent adoption of FlightCore standards, policies, and best practices.

- Partner with the FlightCore Manager to identify workforce development opportunities and capability gaps.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Helicopter Operations, UAS Operations, Aerial Survey, Safety, and support organizations to ensure coordinated mission execution.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

- Serve as a liaison between FlightCore and supported functional areas to improve communication and service delivery.

- Facilitate collaboration across Aviation Services programs to improve operational outcomes.

Core Values

- Communicate with all coworkers and partners with PG&E Purpose, Virtues and Stands at the forefront. Imbodies; t rustworthiness, empathy, curiosity, tenacity, nimbleness and is an owner in service of PG&E Stands:

-

- Everyone and everything is always safe

- Catastrophic wildfires shall stop

- It is enjoyable to work with and for PG&E

- Clean and resilient energy for all

- Our work shall create prosperity for all customers and investors

- Executes work with inclusivity and fosters a speak up environment.

Safety & Compliance

- Support Aviation's Safety Management System (SMS) and continuous improvement efforts.

- Ensure FlightCore processes align with regulatory, company, and operational requirements.

- Support risk identification, corrective action tracking, and operational learning initiatives.

- Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and operational excellence

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

- Eight (8) years of aviation operations, program management, or related experience.

- Demonstrated experience leading complex operational initiatives, programs, or cross-functional projects.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175010

Job Category: Project / Program Management

Job Level: Individual Contributor

Business Unit: Gen Counsel, Ethics, Risk & Compliance

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Oakland

Department Overview

The Projects and Financial Management team within PG&E’s Government Funding Office (GFO) partners with subject matter experts across PG&E to plan, execute, and manage government ‑ funded awards—including loans, grants, and contracts.

The GFO administers PG&E’s $15B loan with the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), delivering $1B in customer savings while maintaining strict compliance with all loan requirements.

As a member of this team, you will work closely with talented and mission-driven colleagues across Finance, Major Projects, Procurement, Environmental, Legal, and Policy to ensure successful award execution and compliance. Our work enables California’s economic prosperity while helping reduce customer costs. Together, we deliver outcomes that create long ‑ term value for both customers and investors.

Position Summary

The Senior Program Manager will play a critical role in identifying, vetting, and submitting PG&E projects for inclusion in PG&E’s DOE loan. This role requires the ability to collaborate effectively with Project Managers, Program Managers, Environmental teams, and Procurement partners to gather and synthesize the data and documentation required for loan and grant submissions.

In addition, this role will support continuously improving our processes for submitting DOE loan projects and ongoing compliance – and support enhancements to dashboards and AI tools.

This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and PG&E’s Oakland-based headquarters on business needs or company requirements.

PG&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint. The final decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

Bay Area Min: $105,000

Bay Area Mid: $137,000

Bay Area Max: $169,000

Job Responsibilities

- Support program management for DOE Loan project submission and compliance.

- May also support program management for grants and other government awards.

- Partner with workstream stakeholders (e.g., Project Management, Program Management, Environmental, Procurement, and other functions) to gather required data and documentation for DOE loan project submission and ongoing compliance

- Identify, vet, and submit eligible projects to the DOE loan

- Serve as a key point of contact for communicating DOE loan requirements, timelines, and expectations to internal partners

- Serve as a key point of contact for communications with DOE regarding project submissions

- Collaborate with team members to continuously improve the DOE loan project submission process

- Support the end-to-end program lifecycle, from project identification through receipt of DOE loan authorization

- Partner with the team to enhance dashboards and AI tools

- Develop recurring and ad ‑ hoc reports, summarize findings, and provide actionable business insights and recommendations

- Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to multiple levels of management

Qualifications

Minimum

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

- 6 years of related experience or equivalent

Desired

- Experience in Project Controls, Project Management, Program Management, or similar discipline

- Experience with major construction projects and environmental permitting

- Previous experience within regulated electric or gas utility and/ or government funded projects

- Experience with Analysis for Office (AO Reports), Power BI, Salesforce, SAP, Snowflake, Microsoft CoPilot, Microsoft Dataverse, and P6

- Master’s degree in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, Finance, Public Policy, Sociology, Engineering, Physics, or a related field—or equivalent experience
